summary: Selected AD-3 as the first board direction. Design basis: AD-3 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, Decisions / Board interface; browser observations are planned and not yet run.

criteria.text: Style the board from AD-3 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, sections Design system and tokens, Components and composition, and Theme. Render the light page with #eef7fb, alternating board cells #e8f1ff and #355b88, a board maximum 34rem, and the focus color #2d4c77; the dark page is #101d2b. Keep the selected-square status below the board with a 34rem maximum and 1rem gap. Check mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x1000 in light and dark themes; observe equal square cells, keyboard focus, and no horizontal overflow. The browser command is planned, not yet run. Serves R-1.
Preserve the local 8 by 8 board: selecting a square updates the polite status with its coordinate, and Reset restores Choose a square. Confirm by node --test; pass when TC-BOARD passes. Serves R-2.

steps.task: Style the board using AD-3 and status, and preserve its selection/reset behavior (C1-C2).

The current structural board stylesheet is present.
